Storefront and customer routes of the products module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/products

List active products

Parameters:

- `brand` in query (string, optional).
- `categoryId` in query (string, optional).
- `ids` in query (string, optional).
- `isFeatured` in query (boolean, optional).
- `maxPrice` in query (number, min 0, optional).
- `minPrice` in query (number, min 0, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `sortBy` in query (string, optional).
- `specs` in query (string, pattern `/^[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]+(,[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]+)*$/`, max length 1024, optional).
- `tags` in query (string, pattern `/^[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]+(,[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]+)*$/`, max length 512, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Products retrieved.
- `400`: Invalid query parameters.

## GET /v1/products/{slug}

Get product by slug

Parameters:

- `slug` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Product retrieved.
- `404`: Product not found.

## GET /v1/products/{slug}/questions

List product questions

Parameters:

- `slug` in path (string, required).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Questions retrieved.
- `404`: Product not found.

## POST /v1/products/{slug}/questions

Create product question

Parameters:

- `slug` in path (string, required).

Request body: [CreateQuestionDto](#createquestiondto).

Responses:

- `201`: Question created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Product not found.

## GET /v1/products/{slug}/reviews

List product reviews

Parameters:

- `slug` in path (string, required).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `rating` in query (number, min 1, max 5, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Reviews retrieved.
- `404`: Product not found.

## POST /v1/products/{slug}/reviews

Create product review

Parameters:

- `slug` in path (string, required).

Request body: [CreateReviewDto](#createreviewdto).

Responses:

- `201`: Review created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.

## GET /v1/products/{slug}/reviews/eligibility

Whether the caller may review this product

Parameters:

- `slug` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Eligibility resolved.
- `401`: Authentication required.
- `404`: Product not found.

## GET /v1/products/{slug}/reviews/mine

Get the caller's own review for a product

Parameters:

- `slug` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Own review retrieved (null when none).
- `401`: Authentication required.
- `404`: Product not found.

## GET /v1/products/{slug}/reviews/summary

Get review summary

Parameters:

- `slug` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Summary retrieved.
- `404`: Product not found.

## GET /v1/products/brands

List brand facets for the catalogue

Parameters:

- `categoryId` in query (string, max length 64, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Brand facets retrieved.
- `400`: Invalid query parameters.

## GET /v1/products/spec-facets

List filterable specification facets

Responses:

- `200`: Facets retrieved.

## Schemas

### CreateQuestionDto

- `question` (string, max length 1000, required).

### CreateReviewDto

- `rating` (number, min 1, max 5, required).
- `title` (string, max length 200, optional).
- `body` (string, max length 5000, required).
- `assetIds` (array of string, optional).
